messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Change the distance intervals for detection probability graph
parts:
Tim:

Your question says you are interested in changing bins just for the graph (not for fitting the detection function).

To change the binning in the plot, simply add the argument "breaks" to your call to plot.  Consult documentation in function plot.ds() in the mrds package.

Example code from the Distance package:

# An example from mrds, the golf tee data.
library(Distance)
data(book.tee.data)
tee.data<-book.tee.data$book.tee.dataframe[book.tee.data$book.tee.dataframe$observer==1,]
ds.model <- ds(tee.data,4)
summary(ds.model)
plot(ds.model)     # default bins
plot(ds.model, breaks=c(0,1,2,3,4))   # user-specified bins
